s188_decision.outcome: K3+TRIMS NOT A SCREEN WINNER: close at the measured numbers (DO-NOT-REPEAT) with the kill-rule readings
s188_decision.rule: screen winner: min k3+trims >= 1.005 x every V3 view (fresh V3 row + 3 in-load V3 views) with every view exact, identical proposals/acceptance and V3 drift <= 3%; chain: also min k3+trims >= 1.02 x every V3 view AND >= 1.02 x 60.659520 = 61.873 tok/s; kill rules recorded: k3 hit saving < 0.25 ms, Bd > D on > 5% of k3 hits, trims remove < 0.105 ms of A
